_comment: The claim set. The fake CLI answers one document per <service>-<operation>, so this
is the union of every stack's resources rather than one stack's - which is exactly
what cleanup-aws.sh builds from the per-stack calls anyway, so the union is faithful
PhysicalResourceIds are what CloudFormation actually reports for these types: the
function NAME for a Lambda (not its ARN), the table name, the bucket name, the pool
id, and the group NAME for a resource group - which is 'voicenotes' with no prefix
hyphen (infrastructure/bootstrap.yaml). That last one matters: the name-prefix veto
would reject it, so this fixture proves the claim check runs first and a live
resource group is never a sweep candidate.
voicenotes-<instance>-api. A fixture that invents a naming scheme teaches the wrong
